senses.gloss: c. (b. h.; a piece of bread, in gen. bread, food, sustenance.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b:11">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 23:25">Ex. XXIII, 25</cite>) <he>זו פת במלח וכ׳</he> that is the morning bread with salt and a ladleful of water.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:6">Ab. Zar. II, 6</cite> <he>והפת והשמן שלהן</he> their (the gentiles’) bread and oil; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 36a:8">ib. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>פִּיתָּן ושמנן</he>.
<cite ref="Horayot 13b:6">Hor. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>פת שלא בשל וכ׳</he> bread not sufficiently cooked (baked).
<cite ref="Horayot 13b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>פת פחמין</he> bread baked on coals.
Gen. R. s. 67 פִּיתְּךָ אפויה, v. אָפָה; a. fr.—[פת כומרין, v. פַּתְכּוּמְרִין.]—Pl. פִּתִּים, פִּתִּין, פִּי׳ pieces.

<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 3:2">Men. III, 2</cite> <he>או שפתתן פ׳ מרובות</he> or if he broke them in too many (small) pieces; <cite ref="Menachot 18b:4">ib. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>מאי פ׳ מרובות שריבה בפתיתין</he> ‘many pieces’ means that he parted the pieces repeatedly; Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., Par. 10, ch. XII (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 2:6">Lev. II, 6</cite>) <he>אותה לפ׳ ואין פִּתֶּיהָ לפ׳</he> thou shalt part it in pieces, but not its pieces again in pieces; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 450:3">Yalk. Lev. 450</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q02174"><he>פָּתִית</he></cite>.
